title: Nevers to Villeroy, Saint-Quentin, 16 August 1595 (BnF fr. 3993 no. 102, ff. 148-149)

documents.shelfmark: BnF Français 3993 no. 102, ff. 148r-149r; Gallica btv1b9059229n canvases 161-162
documents.route: Louis de Gonzague, duc de Nevers (Saint-Quentin) -> Nicolas de Neufville, seigneur de Villeroy (court); Nevers's file copy

plaintext.source: No decipherment on the copy; the Memoires de Nevers (1665) t. 2 does not print the letter (Gallica full-text search on its clear phrases).

transcription.source: Gallica IIIF native resolution (7640 px spreads)
transcription.notes: First pass, one token per sign; the small circle (o) and the zero of '20' are not distinguished; marks over figures (dots) mostly not recorded. Lengths: 301 tokens on f. 148r (ct_f148r.txt) + 452 on ff. 148v-149r (ct_f148v_149r.txt).

system.summary: Clear letter with 17 inserted runs of mixed figures (1 and 2 dominate) and about 45 other signs (Greek-like letters, crossed signs, italic letters). Clear code number 72 in the text.
system.notes: The sign family matches fr. 3995 no. 76 (ff. 142v-143r) and no. 66, but neither assignment reads.

prior_solution.where: Tomokiyo, cryptiana League page (2018-2019): 'Undeciphered', no Nevers-collection key fits.

conditions.human_role: Target chosen by the user from the catalogue; no hand help.

solution.what: Gallica manifest of fr. 3993 (279 canvases, spreads); f. 148 = canvas 161 right, ff. 148v/149r = canvas 162; OAI record: no. 102 'Lettre, avec chiffre ... Copie'.
First transcription of the 17 cipher runs from native-resolution line crops, one token per sign (753 tokens, 54 sign types).
Sign counts: 1 (112), 2 (92), o (74); 1 is followed by another figure in 87% of cases; '2o' 33 times, '41' 14 times; few repeats longer than 4 signs.

Homophonic anneal (fr-1600-letters, order 5), units = two-digit 1x/2x plus single signs; collapsed to 'iiii' (Roman numerals in the corpus), then with a letter-frequency penalty: no French (-2.5/unit). (anneal.py was later shown too weak: it fails its own control.)
Balagny-Nevers alphabet (Tomokiyo's reconstruction from fr. 3993 f. 130): different sign set.

fr. 3995 no. 76 (ff. 142v-143r) read in full: alphabet with figures, letters, lambda, pi, theta, Delta, #, nulls, and a two-cycle word list (dotted 12-99, barred 1-100), names and towns 101-181. Same sign family, but the assignments give no French on the runs and 72 is not a party.
fr. 3995 no. 75 (f. 140, 'chiffre commun entre messieurs les secretaires d'estat'): figures only, no symbols.
fr. 3995 no. 66 (ff. 122v-123r): lambda = n, pi = o, theta = l; no French by hand. Nos. 65, 68-74 (figures, Italian, or blank): no fit.
Memoires de Nevers (1665) t. 2, Gallica full text: exact phrases of the clear text not found; the 1595 Picardy pieces there are other letters.
Anneal with every sign a unit (glyph mode): no French (-2.8/unit).
fr. 3993 no. 133, Nevers to Villeroy 18 Aug 1595 (ff. 173-174), the next letter of the series: all clear, no runs to align.
fr. 3618 ff. 3-4 (key of a cipher used by Nevers, 1591) located in the BnF notice; not digitised.

hsolve.py (incremental 5-gram annealer, letter-frequency penalty, 600k moves) on a matched homophonic control (753 letters of Henri IV letters in the same run lengths, 49 signs + 3 nulls): read letter for letter, -1.84 per window, restarts identical.

hsolve.py on the letter under six unit models (every sign; 1x/2x pairs; every figure pair; 1+sign; decade collapse; no. 65 design with 10/20.. nulls and >=65 codes): best -2.54 to -3.13 per window, restarts disagree, no French.

hsyl.py (unit = letter or consonant+vowel syllable, as in fr. 3995 no. 57) on a syllabic control of the same plaintext: not solved (-2.14/char), so the syllabic hypothesis cannot be tested at this length.
hsyl.py on the letter: no French (-2.16/char).

gaps.detail: key not among fr. 3995 nos. 1-76; as-sent letter not located; syllabic nomenclator of this size beyond ciphertext-only attack (its matched control fails)

outcome.notes: Homophonic one-letter-per-sign readings are ruled out under six unit models by a matched control that solves.
